vulnerability.name: USN-7040-2
vulnerability.description: USN-7040-1 fixed a vulnerability in ConfigObj. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 14.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that ConfigObj contains regex that is susceptible to  catastrophic backtracking. An attacker could possibly use this issue to  cause a regular expression denial of service.

statements.status_notes: ConfigObj could be made to crash if it received specially crafted input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
